_comment: How each Claude Code tool is governed, shared by watchlight-claude-agent (Python) and
@watchlight-ai/agent-plugin-for-claude (TypeScript); each package's copy is tested equal to this file.
governed: decided by Watchlight policy. spawn: a local sub-agent, governed as a spawn. refused: starts
work outside the plugin's hooks; refused before any decision and never offered to the model.
A name not listed here, and not an MCP tool (mcp_tool_pattern), is refused (unclassified_tool).
classified_cli_versions: the Claude Code release each package's locked SDK bundles; an SDK upgrade
fails the pin tests until this list is reviewed against the new release.
local_isolation: the sub-agent isolation values that run in this process; any other value is refused.
